title: ID0400042-DC/Si-D/BE[170003805] - EV issue
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
Abrupt session stop in DC1
Root cause:
EV issue
Solution:
There is no issue with the contactors, the EV has somekind of fault that abruptly stopped the session but kept the CP signal, and caused the EcoG to conflict or error. (B-C-B PilotState while no session on going)
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Siemens
Warranty Status:
Active

In this case it doesn't seem to be a problem with QA09-10, this is just the normal operation that when the session stopped, it “confirmed” that the error-flag is false.
I can confirm but it seems that they changed the metodology in how to report the errors and if there is no problem, then the report is that the Error Flag keeps in false. Here is an example:
I don't think there is any problem. Is this the first time you got this reported? If yes, then I assume it's one time only due to the EV itself.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0400042-DC/Si-D/BE[170003805] - Contactors error CRM:00315002257
additional_info.body:
Hello Francisco
The customer had this problem on the new 400 kW charger. The only thing that I found strange is that the customer was not able to start the session again after it stopped on DC1, socket was in “error”. I think he tried twice but DC1 was in out of order state. Later he tried on DC2 and there is started from the first try.
Br.

additional_info.subject: ID0400042-DC/Si-D/BE[170003805] - Contactors error CRM:00315002257
additional_info.body:
Hi Marnic,
Thank you for the feedback.
Indeed, now I understand the issue, it seems that after this session the EcoG is somehow confused with what to do with this EV, from my point of view, it's very strange that the EV requested to stop at 12%:
But it's still strange that the EcoG had this behavior only after this specific session, since 1 week ago there were 47 sessions:
But I agree that something went wrong with the EcoG, we can see the PilotState going to B2, so my feeling is either the EcoG got some internal conflict/error that we can't see or the PP didn't went through, usually we see this when we get B2 but no P01_Authentication process going.
The only thing I can do remotely is restart the EcoG, but I would like to keep it like this until the next session. If it works then we have a faulty car as root cause that made some kind of problem in EcoG, if it doesn't work then I can restart the EcoG and retry.
What do you think?
BR,
Francisco

And stopped at:

Best regards
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0400042-DC/Si-D/BE[170003805] - Contactors error CRM:00315002257
additional_info.body:
Hi Marnic, good morning.
After checking the logs again I found a session in DC1 that used the QA09-10 and it still doesn't have any error.
My feeling stays the same since the beginning, there must be something wrong with the EV and caused the SECC to go into error/conflict, it's literally impossible for us to short circuit the EV otherwise there would be somekind of trip in our charger before that would happen.
From our side, there is no problem. Please confirm to me if you agree and if you have any other questions/doubts before I close the ticket.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
